prospective_status.adaptive_limit: CBNMS was designed after ALFS and cannot revise the locked ALFS no_go; it is prospective only for these new prompts and remains adaptive method development

source.factor_effect_claim_forbidden: one scenario per cell confounds scenario content with authority/motivation

coordinate.excluded_layer_reason: all slots are prefix positions before the answer suffix/final scoring token, so final-block hook_out has no later attention path from those slots to the next-token logit
coordinate.semantic_anchor_source_certificate: each prompt and construction begins with the same answer-order-twin anchor_prefix, ending in exactly one '[FACTS COMPLETE]\n'; token anchor is the last common token position and is not claimed to be a UTF-8 byte boundary

folds.rule: leave_one_scenario_out; all four held_collateral controls remain held in every fold
folds.staging: write/hash exact training scales, nuisance basis, SP bank bytes, target-only bank bytes, and random-bank freeze manifest before any held-derived arithmetic

numerical_method.nuisance_svd_input: normalize each nonzero nuisance row to unit L2 before SVD; independently certify reconstruction of the original raw nuisance rows
numerical_method.zero_training_residual_norm: serialized scientific no_go with no scales/banks/random manifest; never an integrity abort
numerical_method.training_SP_bank: six positively oriented unit certified nuisance-null directions; SVD only determines rank then canonical twice-reorthogonalized modified Gram-Schmidt
numerical_method.held_primary_solver: analytic two-inequality coefficient QP inside frozen training SP bank; no ambient-nullspace component
numerical_method.held_target_access: target-aware white-box transductive access to the two held target gradients and margins
numerical_method.held_audit_scope_per_direction: exactly 66 rows: own 2 targets + 44 frozen training nuisances + 20 held nuisances

qualification.training_null_gate_scope: nuisance-null primary and random-bank oracles only; the matched target-only bank is not required to be null

controls.random_bank_freeze: persist seed, rank, exact float64 basis byte hash, and construction hash; regenerate one-at-a-time before held use and require exact match
controls.random_bank_training_construction_gate: construct manifest only after nuisance-rank, all six paired solvers, both banks, and exact bank-rank equality pass; otherwise persist empty manifest and no-go reason
controls.random_bank_held_evaluation_gate: regenerate/evaluate only after primary and matched-target-bank 0.01 absolute plus 0.80 relative fold gates pass; otherwise emit ordered replicate 0..31 skipped/false records
controls.matched_non_SP_control: two held other/permanent assignment-pair bank oracles, descriptive and nonselecting
controls.target_only_comparator: capacity-matched six-source training target-only bank; identical canonical bank construction and held coefficient solver; observed rank must exactly equal SP-bank rank without truncation

full_data.if_any_LOSO_gate_fails: write hashed full-data not-evaluated no-go record; do not run full-data SVD/bank because it cannot rescue
full_data.full_data_target_only_bank: not_constructed; only pair-level target-only diagnostics and the eight-source nuisance-null SP bank are produced

state_zero_arithmetic_claim.limitation: earlier-layer edits would change later residual states; no finite forward pass with the multi-layer edit is run in this geometry phase

claim_boundaries.success_means: eligibility to draft and audit a separate finite prospective intervention protocol using newly authored untouched prompts and controls
success_does_not_mean: the model has a natural self-preservation mechanism
authority or motivation caused an effect
claim_boundaries.prior_art_statement: dynamic steering, per-instance coefficients, multi-layer steering, nullspace projection, collateral-damage controls, and activation-steering baselines are prior art
claim_boundaries.finite_phase_minimum_semantic_checks: frozen-direction A/B, X/Y, 1/2 or semantic-label cross-encoding plus open-ended decisions; otherwise only encoding-bound controllability may be claimed
claim_boundaries.possible_contribution_boundary: only the exact behavioral-Jacobian nuisance-null plus frozen low-rank SP-bank transductive conjunction could become a candidate contribution after equal-information/rank/dose finite baselines and independent 2B replication
